info.title: Hospital Management API
info.description: A RESTful API for managing patients, doctors, appointments, medical records, and GitHub OAuth authentication. Developed as part of the CSE 341 Final Project.

tags.name: Authorization
tags.description: GitHub OAuth authorization, user authentication, session status, user profile, and logout endpoints.

tags.name: Patients
tags.description: Patient management endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting patient records.

tags.name: Doctors
tags.description: Doctor management endpoints for managing doctors and their professional information.

tags.name: Appointments
tags.description: Appointment management endpoints for scheduling and managing patient appointments.

tags.name: Medical Records
tags.description: Medical record endpoints for managing diagnoses, symptoms, treatments, medications, and patient medical history.

tags.name: Testing
tags.description: Endpoints related to automated API test status and verification.
